authority_boundary: Research candidate only. Discovery or triage does not establish support, dispute, novelty, priority, external validity, utility, independence, theorem status, EFR result, or any other Project FAR claim/evidence disposition.

stages.description: Source metadata matched governed search and triage rules.
Primary source identity/content and relevance reviewed under governed provenance.
Exact affected claim reconstructed and falsification/derivation executed.
A surviving consequential result awaits independent or otherwise governance-required replication.
Required replication and adjudication artifacts are complete.
Minimal canonical change is prepared with exact dependency fallout and provenance.
Protected merge path accepted and landed the change on main.

transition_rule: No stage may be skipped. Automation can discover, reconcile, validate, and prepare review queues; accepted intellectual content changes only after the repository's governed discovery lifecycle and protected merge path.
core_claim_reopening_rule: A metadata hit, citation, consensus, or model judgment cannot reopen a core claim. A minimized reproducible contradiction satisfying exact canonical premises and negating the exact conclusion may trigger the smallest affected governed correction path.
external_boundary: EFR remains separately preregistered and externally executed; living-repository discovery never counts as EFR execution or external independence.
